aids.nom: Bat Swasdikan Haeng Rat — Carte bien-etre (Bua Thong)
aids.description_en: State Welfare Card (Bua Thong card) for low-income earners with annual income below THB 100,000. Monthly credit: THB 300 (income < THB 30,000/yr) or THB 200 (income THB 30,001-100,000/yr) for food/goods at registered shops. Additional THB 400 (income < THB 30,000/yr) or THB 200 for utility subsidies. Plus bus/BTS/MRT public transport discount. Source: cgd.go.th.

aids.nom: Ngoen Chuai Liao Phu Yao Su — Allocation personnes agees
aids.description_en: Universal old age allowance for Thai citizens aged 60+: THB 600/month (age 60-69), THB 700/month (age 70-79), THB 800/month (age 80-89), THB 1,000/month (age 90+). Disbursed quarterly through local government (OrBorTor). Source: dss.go.th (Budget Law 2568).
aids.organisme: Krom Sangkhom Sungwai lae Phatthana Chumchon (DSS) / OrBorTor

aids.description_en: Universal Health Coverage (UHC/UC scheme). Free primary care at registered public health centres and hospitals. Standard co-payment THB 30 per visit (often waived in practice). Covers outpatient, inpatient, essential medicines, surgery, chronic diseases, maternity. 47 million beneficiaries. Managed by NHSO. Source: nhso.or.th.
aids.organisme: Samnak Ngan Lak Prakan Sukkhaphap Haeng Chat (NHSO)

aids.nom: Ngoen Chuai Liao Khon Phikan — Allocation handicap
aids.description_en: Monthly disability allowance of THB 800/month for persons registered in the disability registry. Additional THB 1,000 supplement for those with severe disability welfare card (income < THB 100,000/yr). Disbursed quarterly through OrBorTor. Source: dep.go.th / dss.go.th.
aids.organisme: Krom Songserm lae Phatthana Khunna-phap Chiiwit Khon Phikan (DEP) / DSS

aids.nom: Ngoen Anuthan Dek Kaeo — Allocation enfant (0-6 ans)
aids.description_en: Child support allowance of THB 600/month per child aged 0-6 years for families with income below THB 100,000/year. Extended to children aged 0-6 in low-income households registered in the state welfare system. Paid monthly. Source: dss.go.th.
aids.organisme: Krom Sangkhom Sungwai lae Phatthana Chumchon (DSS)

aids.description_en: Unemployment insurance under Social Security Office (SSO). Benefit: 50% of last registered wage, maximum THB 7,500/month (50% of THB 15,000 wage ceiling), for up to 180 days per year. Voluntary/early termination: 30% of wage, max 90 days. Source: sso.go.th (Social Security Act B.E. 2533).

Social Security (SSO Section 33/39/40) contributions-based benefits: retirement pension at 55+ after 15 years of contributions (pension amount depends on salary and tenure, typically 15-20% of salary); disability benefit (50% of wage); maternity (THB 15,000 lump sum + 50% wage for 90 days). Employee 5% + employer 5% of salary. Source: sso.go.th.

aids.nom: Krop Thun Khu Yum Yu SOS — Pret etudiant (GYS)
aids.description_en: Student loan from Student Loan Fund (GYS/Kro Phet Khu Yum Yu Sos). Up to THB 90,000/year covering tuition fees and living expenses. 0% interest during study and 1% per year during repayment (5-15 years). For students from families with income < THB 360,000/year. Source: studentloan.or.th.
aids.organisme: Krop Thun Khu Yum Yu Sos (GYS — Student Loan Fund)

aids.nom: Sap Sap Kha Fai Fa — Subvention electricite (Baan Meng Khong)
aids.description_en: Electricity subsidy for welfare card holders: first 50 kWh/month free (electricity bill waived up to THB 230/month equivalent). For households consuming under 50 units, zero payment. For 51-100 units, 50% discount. Managed by Provincial Electricity Authority (PEA) and Metropolitan Electricity Authority (MEA). Source: cgd.go.th / dss.go.th.

Subsidized social rental housing by National Housing Authority (NHA). Rent THB 800-2,500/month for low-income households. Purchase price below market rate. For families with income < THB 30,000/month and no owned property. Source: nha.co.th.

aids.nom: Sap Sap Kha Nam Prapa — Subvention eau (carte bien-etre)
aids.description_en: Water utility subsidy for welfare card holders: THB 100/month credit for piped water bill. For welfare card holders with income < THB 30,000/year: THB 100/month; income THB 30,001-100,000/year: THB 70/month. Applied automatically via welfare card to MWA/PWA accounts. Source: cgd.go.th.
aids.organisme: Kra Suat Maha Nakhon Nai Phak / MWA / PWA
